Single quiet continuous pale sand-grey/taupe interior wash, only slightly darker than the scene's cream terrace floor. The natural boundary is a thin softly hand-painted ivory perimeter, intermittently broken in a few broad soft sections as in reference image 1; subtle inner pale warm-grey earth transition. Clean flat ground plane, no raised walls, no planter, no trench, no thick ring. Absolutely NO parallel furrows, rectangular edges, grid, ridge bands, dots, grain, speckles or scratchy texture. Refined restrained pale Chinese watercolor with broad simple washes, very little texture, soft but clearly readable outer oval at 140–230 pixels wide. Empty centre fully open and visibly filled with pale soil, suitable for placing a tea shrub with its root precisely at the oval's centre. Transparent exterior, no opaque matte, no detached shadow, no glow; generous clear margins, whole shape unclipped. No seedlings, leaves, grass, stones, pots, people, tools, fences, signpost, labels, calligraphy, text, watermark, multiple patches, collage, furniture, UI ornament, high contrast, saturated brown, orange, muddy dirt, noisy edges or any extra object. One subtle oval soil circle only.
